# Beyond the Symbol

> Readings of your own birth chart, Human Design and Gene Keys, written in plain language by the AI you already use (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, free versions are enough). Each product is an instant download sold on Gumroad. No astrology knowledge and no accounts needed.

## Made for you
- Your 2027 ($16): a personal year ahead reading of about 20 pages, made from your birth date, time and place. What each month brings, which parts of your life move forward, and the dates when it pays to act. PDF by email within 3 days. https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/your-2027

## Readings ($7 each)
- Beloved: two readings and a 45-page guide. How you love, from your own chart, plus a reading of a connection from both charts. https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/beloved
- Destiny: twelve chapters on what you came here to do, with a 27-page guide. https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/destiny
- The Money Map: eleven chapters on where your work and money live in your chart. Names no job titles and promises no sums. https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/the-work
- Character Study: twelve chapters on your lasting character, with a 31-page guide. https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/character-study

## Starter guides
- AI Read My Chart (free, pay what you like): where to get your full chart free and one prompt that turns it into a written reading. 14-page PDF. https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/ai-read-my-chart
- The Astrologer Within ($3): a guide to reading your own birth chart. A 35-page beginner guide plus a prompt system. https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/ncflmm

## Calendars
- Astrological Calendar 2026 (free, pay what you like): every new moon, full moon, eclipse and retrograde of 2026, month by month. https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/trhvca
- Astrological Calendar 2027 ($3). https://beyondthesymbol.gumroad.com/l/calendar-2027

## How it works
1. A guide walks you to free chart sites (no account or email needed).
2. One button opens your AI with the reading already loaded; you paste your charts.
3. The AI writes the reading chapter by chapter.
